blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — To tighten security across Northern Mindanao and the Caraga region, the Army’s 4th Infantry Division (4ID) has deployed 110 newly trained community “lead scouts” to serve as force multipliers on the ground. The new Civilian Armed Forces Geographical Unit (CAFGU) Active Auxiliaries (CAAs) completed their basic military training on Tuesday at the 4th Infantry Division Training School in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon. The Army expects the new militiamen to augment regular troops by securing vital installations, gathering local intelligence, and supporting law enforcement agencies.
